run_when: The rules found no corporation or LLC on record.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company itself is a sole proprietorship or a partnership (general, limited or limited liability partnership).
prompt.definition: Exclusions need positive evidence. Sole proprietorships and partnerships can't be served today (services ICP). A company that is a corporation (Inc., Corp., PBC) or an LLC is not one.
yes_when: The company states it is a sole proprietorship or a partnership
Its own legal name ends in LLP, LP or 'General Partnership'
no_when: Its legal name or terms show a corporation (Inc., Corp., PBC) or an LLC
unknown_when: Only a person's name or a trade name is shown, with no entity type
watch_out_for: Terms that talk about customers ('if you are a sole proprietor...') are about the customer, not the company
Law and accounting firms named 'Partners' may still be LLCs or corporations: answer from the stated entity, not the brand
'Partner' in 'our partners' or 'partner program' is not a partnership

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

web_search.note: An exclusion found on the web counts only with high confidence and an entity match by domain.
